title: Homelab
description: Hosts and nspawn services from telegraf metrics in VictoriaMetrics. Hosts and services are discovered from the data, nothing is hardcoded.

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: Hosts that reported system metrics in the last few minutes.

panels.title: Running services
panels.description: nspawn containers with a live cgroup on the selected hosts.

panels.title: Service memory limits
panels.description: Sum of MemoryMax across running services. Compare with host memory: this is the worst case if every service hit its limit.

panels.title: Service CPU in use
panels.description: Total CPU cores currently consumed by all services.

panels.title: Services
panels.description: One row per running service. Click a column header to sort.

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Percentage of all cores in use (100 − idle). The dashed line is time spent waiting on I/O.

panels.title: Memory used vs total
panels.description: Solid = used (excludes page cache), dashed = installed total. Both share one legend name, so one click toggles the pair.

panels.title: Host filesystems
panels.description: Used % per mounted filesystem, excluding per-service volumes (see the Services row).

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Positive = read, negative = write. Both directions share one legend name and colour, so clicking a legend entry shows/hides both together. The legend has two rows per entry: the top row's stats are read, the bottom row's are write. Whole block devices only (partitions and LVM dm-* volumes are hidden).

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Positive = rx, negative = tx. Both directions share one legend name and colour, so clicking a legend entry shows/hides both together. The legend has two rows per entry: the top row's stats are rx, the bottom row's are tx. Host interfaces only; container veths are in the Services row.

panels.title: Temperatures
panels.description: Drive temperatures from SMART and any lm_sensors chips telegraf finds on the host.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores consumed by each service (from the container's cgroup cpu.stat).

panels.title: Memory used, % of limit
panels.description: cgroup memory.current as a percentage of the MemoryMax limit, so every service is on the same 0–100 scale. Absolute used-vs-limit is in the Service detail row.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Positive = rx, negative = tx. Both directions share one legend name and colour, so clicking a legend entry shows/hides both together. The legend has two rows per entry: the top row's stats are rx, the bottom row's are tx. Measured on each container's veth on the host.

panels.title: Service volumes
panels.description: Used % of each per-service LVM volume mounted under /var/lib/volumes.

panels.title: Memory used vs limit
panels.description: Solid = memory.current, dashed = MemoryMax. Same legend name per service, so one click toggles the pair. Narrow the service variable to keep this readable.

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Scheduler periods per second in which the service hit its CPUQuota. Non-zero means it wants more CPU than allowed.
